13 changes of the filter or volume registers between note starts are not written; the values are updated at note starts only.

Records are timed with TI (60 Hz, 16.7 ms steps) and the interpreter writes one register about every 10 ms: predicted note start error 5 ms mean, 7 ms maximum; the phase of TI adds up to 17 ms, and gate-offs are less exact than note starts. 5 gate-offs shortly before the next note of a voice are written together with that note.
